{{Quote|TK-3207, report to Test Bay 94. TK-3207, report to Test Bay 94.|Imperial public address voice|<ref name="Star Wars: Behind the Magic">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref>}}
'''TK-3207''' was the designation of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] who participated as the test subject in a weapons test procedure, carried out in [[Test Bay 94]].

==Behind the scenes==
TK-3207 appears in the interactive "Weapon Comparison Test Bay" feature in the [[1998]] [[Wikipedia:Personal computer|PC]] [[Star Wars video games|program]] ''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''. The stormtrooper is called in to be the next test subject after the player tests the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] on a previous stormtrooper subject. The player may then choose from five weapons to sample on TK-3207: "[[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] Rock," "[[Blaster/Legends|Blaster]]," "Lightsaber," "[[Thermal detonator/Legends|Thermal Detonator]]," and "[[Superlaser/Legends|Death Star Ray]]."
